title: John Mack's abduction cases were done by humans

tellings.quote: but what they didn't know every one of those cases that were being funneled to him Yeah. were all done by humans.

plain: Steven Greer, a researcher who campaigns for governments to reveal what they know about UFOs, talks on Jesse Michels's podcast about John Mack, a Harvard psychiatrist who studied people reporting alien abductions in the 1990s, and Budd Hopkins, another abduction researcher. Greer says that, without the researchers knowing it, every one of the cases being funneled to Mack was actually carried out by humans. If true, some famous abductions were staged by people, not aliens.
